# clerk_role_set (Resource)

Manages a Clerk role set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_role_set" "default" {
  name             = "Default Role Set"
  key              = "role_set:default_roles"
  description      = "Default set of roles assigned to new organization members"
  default_role_key = clerk_organization_role.member.key
  creator_role_key = clerk_organization_role.admin.key
  roles            = [clerk_organization_role.member.key, clerk_organization_role.admin.key, clerk_organization_role.editor.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `creator_role_key` (String) Key of the role assigned to the creator of an organization.
- `default_role_key` (String) Key of the role automatically assigned to new organization members.
- `key` (String) Unique key for the role set.
- `name` (String) Display name of the role set.
- `roles` (List of String) List of role keys to include in this role set. Must include default_role_key and creator_role_key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the role set.
- `type` (String) Type of the role set (initial or custom).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the role set was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the role set.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the role set was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_role_set.example <role_set_id>
```
